title: Policy Document
description: Canonical extraction target for a Policy document (Fideon SPEC_00 PolicyCheckDocument, doc_type 'policy'). Policy documents are the type most likely to carry several organisation names on one page - insured, carrier, producer, certificate holder - so the exclusion clauses in the shared field definitions are load-bearing here (arch 0c).

coverage_schedule.description: The coverages listed on the policy, one entry per coverage. Usually found on the declarations page or a schedule page.

coverage_name.description: The name of the coverage as the document states it, for example General Liability or Hired Auto.

limit.description: The limit of liability for this coverage, as a number without currency symbols or separators. Not the deductible and not the premium.

deductible.description: The deductible or retention for this coverage, as a number. Not the limit.

premium.description: The premium attributable to this coverage alone. Not the policy total premium.

endorsements.description: Endorsement forms attached to the policy, by form number or title as listed.
